end_to_end_per_frame.description: person detect + weapon detect on 2 persons

live_pipeline_fps.note: Live FPS includes ByteTrack tracking, WeaponVerifier, BehaviorAnalyzer, RiskEngine, and JPEG encoding. Weapon detection runs every 5 frames (weapon_skip=5), so effective throughput is higher.

optimization_notes: Both models use FP16 (half=True) reducing memory ~50% vs FP32
Weapon detection runs every 5 frames (weapon_skip=5) not every frame
Person detection runs every 1 frame on GPU, every 3 on CPU
Stream manager pre-encodes JPEG in pipeline thread — zero encoding cost on HTTP requests
ByteTrack persists track IDs across frames — no re-detection overhead
